observations: Role 511 indexes a fixed 16-building array and runtime samples using packed counts, dimensions and offsets; a reserved zero count lane maintains a two-by-two interpolation. Nonzero cell dimensions, building counts, sample ranges and room identity consistency need host producer proof.

Role 512 uses light and appearance uniforms with a sampled lunar albedo; roles 513 and 514 use different mesh and billboard paths, with the latter interpreting the normal channel as pebble-center data and using derivatives for pixel coverage. Asset metadata and producer contracts remain untraced.

Roles 515 and 516 use the frozen bevy_eidolon instanced vertex ABI, yaw-based normal rotation and visibility-dither rules. Bark color and height lanes have distinct meanings; the leaf body samples opacity, front/back albedo and ARM, while normal textures remain bound but unused in this frozen version. Current shader identities and pipeline policy require separate assessment.
Role 517 maps an equatorial direction, magnitude and color to viewport-sized star quads. Viewport dimensions, astronomical units, retained magnitude and scene inputs are not proved by this body.

Role 518 decodes ground-map channels as categorical cover and substrate codes, applies weather/litter/terrain materials and source/world transforms, including division by transform diagonals. Nonzero axis scale, finite fade bounds, packed channel ownership and CPU material admission remain open.

Roles 519 and 520 apply aggregate bark shading and a level-selected tree impostor with eight atlas views in three columns. Atlas layout, level encoding, transforms, alpha and LOD selection must be connected to the relevant producers and material pipelines.
